name: PRC Civil Engineering (CELE)

subjects.name: Principles of Structural Analysis and Design
subjects.coverage: Engineering mechanics, strength of materials, and structural analysis. Design of steel, reinforced and prestressed concrete members, connections and foundations. Also covers materials testing and engineering codes.

subjects.name: Applied Mathematics, Surveying, Principles of Transportation and Highway Engineering, Construction Management and Methods
subjects.coverage: Calculus, differential equations, data analysis, numerical methods, physics and engineering economics. Also covers construction surveying and layout, materials, transport and highway engineering, site safety, quantity estimates and construction management.

subjects.name: Hydraulics and Principles of Geotechnical Engineering
subjects.coverage: Fluid properties, pressure, flow, buoyancy and water supply. Geotechnical topics include soil classification, seepage, soil stresses and strength, bearing capacity, compaction, settlement, earth pressure and slope stability.
